## ⚠️ Please read first — this report has no numbers, and here's the plain-English why

I was not able to pull your Sponsored Products data, so there are **no figures in this report**. I did **not** make any numbers up.

**What happened, in simple terms:**
- Your four Amazon login details (client ID, secret, refresh token, profile ID) are **present and working** — I used them to log in to Amazon successfully.
- But this automated environment is **not allowed to reach Amazon's advertising data servers**. Every attempt to connect to them was blocked at the network gate (a "403 / connection refused" — a security rule, not a problem with your account or passwords).
- Blocked servers: `advertising-api.amazon.com`, `advertising-api-eu.amazon.com`, and `advertising-api-fe.amazon.com` (Amazon's North America, Europe, and Far East data servers).

**What I tried:**
- Logged in to Amazon (worked).
- Tried to download campaign and keyword performance from all three regional Amazon servers (each one blocked).
- Checked the network diagnostics to confirm it was a blocking rule, not a glitch — confirmed.
- I did **not** retry endlessly or try to sneak around the block, because the system's own guidance says a block like this must be lifted by a person, not worked around.

**What YOU need to do to fix it (one-time):**
Add Amazon's advertising data server to this environment's list of allowed websites (its "outbound network allowlist"). Use the one for your selling region:
- Selling in **North America** → allow `advertising-api.amazon.com`
- Selling in **Europe/UK** → allow `advertising-api-eu.amazon.com`
- Selling in **Japan/Australia** → allow `advertising-api-fe.amazon.com`

This is set in the environment's network settings. Guide: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web

Once that's allowed, the next scheduled run will pull real numbers automatically — the code is already written and ready.

**One more thing — email could not be sent.** This session has no email tool connected, so I could not send the report to uzoebo.archbold@gmail.com by email. You're getting the alert via the routine notification (phone + inbox) instead. If you want a real email each time, an email/Gmail connector needs to be added to this environment.
